name: scaffold-hbar-clip-wallet
description: Your own non-custodial wallet on the Clip Wallet kit: a branded browser extension (14 network families, 1Mask for every dapp, decoded approvals, a security floor that can't be switched off) plus a Scaffold-HBAR Next.js dapp that connects to it on Hedera testnet, with the debug page. Testnet by default; mainnet behind a checklist. Same project as `npx create-clip-wallet`.

sections.title: Give the wallet its own identity

steps.label: Name, reverse domain you own, extension key, icon, listing drafts

steps.text: Same result as `npx create-clip-wallet`. Add --walletconnect-project-id <id> for your own WalletConnect project.

sections.title: Build and try it on Hedera testnet

steps.text: Load packages/extension/.output/chrome-mv3 unpacked in chrome://extensions, then create a wallet in it.

steps.label: Start the demo dapp (connect, sign, send, /debug)

steps.text: Listing-submission drafts for your identity are in docs/listings (pnpm wallet:listings regenerates them).
Mainnet stays off until packages/extension/MAINNET.md is done: pnpm wallet:mainnet-check shows what is left.
AGENTS.md has recipes for rebranding, networks, tokens, routing, security and plugins.
